long_biography.plain_text:
Taking charge of OMK's Vyksa plant in 1999 made Anatoly Sedykh responsible for an industrial business in crisis. He restored the operation and made it the production core of OMK, pairing factory leadership with responsibility for the wider group. The assignment established his operating authority before he moved into company-wide governance.

Sedykh changed his formal role as the organisation matured. He served as director general, president and management-board chairman before returning to the board chair in 2017. That position separates strategic oversight from executive management. OMK's board sets investment, performance, safety and sustainability priorities, while the management team runs operations. As chair, Sedykh directs the board's work and oversees the executive bodies.
long_biography.html:
Taking charge of OMK's Vyksa plant in 1999 made Anatoly Sedykh responsible for an industrial business in crisis. He restored the operation and made it the production core of OMK, pairing factory leadership with responsibility for the wider group. The assignment established his operating authority before he moved into company-wide governance.

Sedykh changed his formal role as the organisation matured. He served as director general, president and management-board chairman before returning to the board chair in 2017. That position separates strategic oversight from executive management. OMK's board sets investment, performance, safety and sustainability priorities, while the management team runs operations. As chair, Sedykh directs the board's work and oversees the executive bodies.
